display_name: Korea AI Framework Act and Enforcement Decree: the AI business operator's questions on safety, incident reporting (none stated), the domestic representative, investigations and fines
method: SOLO encoding-a-subject workflow from a pinned brief (one session, Opus 5.5). Korean sources fetched from law.go.kr and deposited with provenance; every quotation generated by srcrefs.py quoteid and checked with --strict; nouns first; rules for the provisions that speak to an AI business operator; seat questions with plain inputs; tests written by hand from the Korean. Then an independent test pass by a separate model agent (tests-independent.l4, answers written first in tests-independent-answers-first.md): 117 assertions, all satisfied; it raised forks F12 and F13 and a rewording of finding 5. No human gate.
seat: an AI business operator (인공지능사업자, Act Article 2(7)): a developer that develops and provides AI, or a utilization operator that provides AI products or services using a developer's AI
edition_encoded: The Act as consolidated on law.go.kr on 2026-10-24 ([시행 2026. 7. 21.] [법률 제21311호, 2026. 1. 20., 일부개정]); the Enforcement Decree as consolidated ([시행 2026. 8. 20.] [대통령령 제36580호, 2026. 8. 18., 타법개정]) and its Annex 2. The provisions encoded have read the same since the Act and the Decree took effect on 2026-01-22. Korean: ../../registers/source-bundle/kr-ai-act-ko.txt, kr-ai-decree-ko.txt, kr-ai-decree-annex2-ko.txt. English translation read, not deposited.
versions_encoded: One text for the provisions encoded; commencement (2026-01-22) is a date question. No draft notice is encoded.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted Korean statutory texts are not protected by copyright (Copyright Act Art 7 items 1 and 2), see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
scope: Rules for Act Articles 2(7), 4 (with Decree Art 2), 31(1) (with Decree Art 23(4) items 1-2), 32 (with Decree Art 24), 36 (with Decree Art 29), 40, 43 (with Decree Art 32 and Annex 2), and commencement; the incident-reporting answer (no duty stated; nearest duty Art 32(1) item 2 and 32(2)); the grace-period answer (none in law). Every other Article of the Act and the Decree is a row of the coverage table in NOTES.md. Deferred: an L4 provisions table of every article; Decree Art 25's confirmation clocks; Art 2(4)'s high-impact list as a rule.
not_reviewed: Nobody but the encoding session has read this encoding against the source. No domain expert and no lawyer qualified in Korea has read it. No claim is made that it is correct, complete or fit to be relied on as legal advice.
